name: Swiggy Instamart
tagline: Swiggy's quick-commerce arm delivering groceries and essentials in minutes
facts: Swiggy Ltd (listed Nov 2024); Swiggy Instamart Pvt Ltd
CM -0.2% of GOV Q1 FY27; breakeven May 2026

strategy.label: Mission
strategy.text: Elevate the quality of life of urban consumers by offering unparalleled convenience (Swiggy group mission).

strategy.label: Vision
strategy.text: Be the default app for anything a household needs in minutes, from milk to electronics.

strategy.label: Core strategy
strategy.text: Pause blitz-scaling; densify stores, lift AOV via Maxxsaver and bigger megapods, chase contribution and then EBITDA breakeven.

strategy.label: Moat
strategy.text: Swiggy's shared fleet, One membership and food-delivery traffic cut CAC; cross-sell from food users.

strategy.label: Key bet
strategy.text: IOCC status (foreign holding capped 49.5%) to own inventory, raising margins; ₹10,000 cr QIP war chest (Dec 2025).

strategy.label: Your view
strategy.text: Instamart's order share fell from 34% to 21%. Was slowing store expansion for margins the right call versus Blinkit?

customers.pain: Forgot milk, bread or veggies; no time for kirana trips
customers.why: Fast delivery, wide assortment, and same app as Swiggy food orders

customers.pain: Quick commerce felt expensive and limited for big baskets
customers.why: Maxxsaver discounts on larger carts (28% order penetration) plus Swiggy One free delivery

customers.who: Young professionals buying gifts, gadgets, beauty
customers.why: Electronics, toys, beauty and gifting categories delivered within minutes

customers.pain: Need fast-growing digital shelf and measurable performance ads
customers.why: Search and display ads, sampling, and city-level demand data on 13.5M users

customers.who: Gig riders shared across Swiggy food and Instamart
customers.pain: Income volatility, safety pressure from speed promises
customers.why: Batching across food and grocery raises utilisation and per-hour earnings

portfolio.key_metrics: Ad revenue % of GOV, member penetration, revenue per order
portfolio.guardrails: Fee-driven churn, ad clutter in search, price perception

portfolio.key_metrics: Category attach rate, gross margin, repeat purchase
portfolio.guardrails: Cannibalising core, ops complexity, quality complaints

rows.how: Commission now; buy-sell margin once Instamart owns inventory
Delivery, handling, small-cart and late-night fees per order
CPC search ads, display, sampling and data insights
Swiggy One subscription bundling food and grocery benefits

bullets.label: Revenue mix
bullets.text: Est. mostly commissions plus customer fees; ads a fast-rising high-margin slice; revenue per order ₹108 in Q1 FY27.

bullets.label: Users vs payers
bullets.text: Consumers pay fees; brands pay commissions and ads; riders paid per trip by Swiggy.

bullets.label: Unit economics
bullets.text: CM moved from about -4.6% to -0.2% of GOV in a year; 45%+ stores CM-positive; guided EBITDA breakeven ~Jun 2027.

bullets.label: Growth levers
bullets.text: Higher AOV categories, ads, owned inventory margin, tier-2 cities, Swiggy One cross-sell from food users.

friction: Stock-outs and substitutions on fresh produce
Hidden handling, surge and small-cart fees at checkout
Delivery slower than Blinkit in many pin codes
Separate app and tab confuse first-time users
Refunds for damaged or expired items feel slow

competitors.label: Quick commerce
competitors.text: Blinkit (leader, 2,443 stores), Zepto, BigBasket BB Now

competitors.label: E-commerce entrants
competitors.text: Amazon Now, Flipkart Minutes, JioMart quick delivery

competitors.label: Offline
competitors.text: Kiranas, DMart, Reliance Smart, local fruit sellers

competitors.label: Edge
competitors.text: Shared Swiggy fleet and Swiggy One bundle lower cost per order

competitors.label: Risk
competitors.text: Losing scale race to Blinkit; Amazon/Flipkart deep pockets compress margins

news.label: Jul 2026
news.text: Q1 FY27: GOV ₹7,907 cr, CM breakeven reached in May, 1,171 stores

news.label: Jan 2026
news.text: Dropped 10-minute delivery claims after Labour Ministry nudge on rider safety

news.label: Dec 2025
news.text: Swiggy raised ₹10,000 cr via QIP, mostly for Instamart network and marketing

news.label: Watch
news.text: IOCC inventory model, EBITDA breakeven by Jun 2027, share vs Blinkit

sources: Swiggy Q1 FY27 shareholder letter, Inc42, Business Standard, Outlook Business coverage. Metrics are PM estimates for interview prep. Prepared Oct 2026.
